owner: Single owner on one local-first worker/app installation.
prerequisites: App workspace exported once to initialize the local worker
Private authorized CSV path with completed US equity/ETF daily bars
Owner machine awake during a locally installed schedule
Supported secure web browser with File System Access API

oneTimeSetup.action: Initialize the local SQLite worker from the app workspace backup and create a private consistent backup.
Select a private handoff directory once in web Settings → Workspace and data → Local worker review handoff.
oneTimeSetup.permissions: The browser stores its owner-selected directory handle in local IndexedDB. It can be re-granted through Check for worker updates.

oneTimeSetup.action: If desired, the owner installs and monitors a scheduler that invokes the local CLI after data publication.
oneTimeSetup.truth: StockLedger does not install the scheduler. The machine must be awake and the authorized CSV path readable.

closedAppWorkerRun.commandTemplate: npm run worker -- --managed --db /absolute/private/worker.sqlite --csv /absolute/private/daily-bars --adjustment adjusted --source 'Authorized provider/dataset release' --handoff-dir /absolute/private/stockledger-handoff
closedAppWorkerRun.fullWorkspaceExport: Not produced unless the operator explicitly supplies --output FILE.
closedAppWorkerRun.externalNotification: Optional server-only transport; not required for in-app review.

laterAppOpen: The app checks the owner-granted folder and validates pending.json contract/checksum/workspace/sequence/evidence.
A valid batch appends captured evaluations and alerts to the existing workspace, subject to owner-state conflict checks.
The app persists by compare-and-set with a retained previous valid copy, then writes the matching ack.json receipt.
Review captured source context in Today and Alerts; make any decision deliberately in Journal.
The worker consumes ack.json on its next invocation and deletes only the acknowledged batch prefix.

failurePath.permission: Owner re-grants access or selects a new folder.
failurePath.conflict: No guessed merge; owner reviews unchanged app state and resolves the underlying Eye/stock/recipe/metric edit explicitly.
failurePath.malformedOrPartial: Last valid app state is kept; status remains truthful and the durable worker batch can retry.
failurePath.appRecovery: Restore the app's prior validated saved copy; worker pending batch remains replay-safe.

reverseAppToWorker: Still an explicit revision-gated full import for owner-authored changes that must affect later worker evaluations: pause the schedule, export intentionally, create a before-import SQLite backup, and import at the exact worker revision.
notClaimed: Human review until the owner acts
